summary: AI Financial Corp filed an 8-K reporting the sale of its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary ALT 5 Sigma Canada, Inc. to Prime Delta Corp. The consideration comprised a $12 million secured promissory note and 11,551,750 restricted shares of Prime common stock. The note bears 4% interest, with $1 million due August 11, 2026, and the balance payable via 20% of Prime's post-closing equity financings or four annual installments of $2.75 million starting 2027. The transaction closed August 3, 2026. This divestiture aligns with the registrant's strategic disposition of its Canadian operations. Watch for future Prime equity financings affecting note repayment timing.
